claim_stages.definition: Behaviour and outcome observed in one run.
Performance observed across every locked operational form under one exact profile and measurement contract.
permits: local improvement tracking under the same profile

claim_stages.definition: A calibrated inference over a defined universe with facet, form-equivalence, invariance, uncertainty and prospective validity evidence.

legacy_band_surface.exclusion_statement: lib/ecd-contract.mjs names the ability categories in order to refuse them and sets band to null on every result it issues, and lib/result-schema.mjs carries that null onto the profile-bound result and its schema forbids any other value. Both are excluded by name rather than by a pattern, so each exclusion is one line somebody has to write rather than a gap a rename could open.
legacy_band_surface.statement: lib/scorer-v1.mjs assigns an ability category to a legacy v1 result and lib/report.mjs, lib/report-card.mjs and lib/dashboard.mjs render it for the legacy records that carry one. Since #559 the assessment path writes a profile result and lib/cli.mjs prints no category at all, so it has left this list. Nothing in this contract reads a category, produces one or is derived from one, and no cell, construct or index defined here can acquire one. Issue #568 owns removing the remaining legacy surfaces. Until then the absence of an ability category is a property of this contract and of the active path, and this artifact lists every module that still carries one rather than asserting the wider claim.

intended_uses: tracking change under the same exact profile and contract

comparability_rules.statement: Two results scored under different measurement contracts are two instruments. A difference between them may be a difference between the contracts and cannot be read as a difference between the runs.
Two results whose declared level differs on any of these facets may not be compared directly until measurement-invariance or DIF evidence supports the comparison.

Two results from different profiles are two measurements. A difference between them is not a change in the operator, and a result that does not identify its profile cannot be shown to share one with anything.

inferences.claim: Canonical events, effects and task oracles are converted into the declared observable cells correctly.
assumptions: Every cell names an evidence authority and no cell inherits one.
A subcheck belongs to exactly one cell, so no observation is counted twice.
Missing evidence is preserved as NOT_OBSERVED, INSUFFICIENT_OPPORTUNITIES or WITHHELD and never converted to 0, PASS or FAIL.

evidence.detail: checkContract proves every M01-M20 subcheck maps to exactly one cell and one axis, and that no cell claims a subcheck that does not exist.
The cell, construct and index arithmetic is deterministic and is exercised by fixture vectors.
The FAM-5 verifier runs out of process and strips the nonce and argv before loading the assessed module.
The counterfactuals in this contract are tests, counted in counterfactual_tests and checked against the file, and the guards they rest on are in the mutation manifest.
Not every cell's evidence is retained as raw bytes; some are retained as grader verdicts.

rebuttals.detail: Two cells are read from agent declarations with no effect behind them. Both are credit_bearing false and neither is required for its construct.
Operator process cells are read from canonical events the agent cannot write.
Several graders match against terms the family brief already names, so copying the brief can satisfy them.
One verifier, one rater implementation, no agreement study.
A cell below its minimum yields null with INSUFFICIENT_OPPORTUNITIES rather than a partial value.

inferences.claim: The completed locked forms summarise the sampled profile conditions.
assumptions: Every locked operational form was completed exactly once.
The exact profile and measurement contract identity is recorded with the result.
Operational forms are distinguished from warmup and practice, and exposure is tracked.
Opportunity count, coverage, spread and uncertainty are visible in the result.

evidence.detail: The combined contract digest is recorded on every result and is a gated comparability facet, so two results scored under different contracts are refused rather than compared.

A result that does not carry a profile identity cannot reach PROFILE_BOUND: the claim stage requires every facet the comparability rules gate to be declared, and the profile digest is one of them. A digest that is carried is compared, so two results under different profiles are refused.

What a profile digest is computed over is not defined here. Issue #559 owns the profile shape and its aggregation; this contract requires that one is bound and compares it, and does not invent what goes into it.
evaluate refuses a forms_completed list that repeats a form or names one the task model does not declare, so the assumption above is enforced rather than assumed.
Completion is checked per cycle; no evidence establishes that a partially completed cycle is comparable to a complete one.
The task model requires an exposure ledger; this contract does not implement one.
Opportunity counts and distributions are reported. No interval, standard error or method is claimed.

rebuttals.detail: A construct estimate is withheld unless every required cell is issued, so dropping a form withholds rather than improves.
Sequence and occasion are declared facets but no exposure ledger enforces single administration.
Difficulty is UNESTABLISHED for every form.
The runtime version is probed and recorded, which makes drift visible and does not correct for it.
One occasion per cycle. No variance component is estimated.

inferences.claim: The profile predicts performance across a specified universe of coding-agent operating situations.
assumptions: An explicit universe of operating situations is defined.
Facet variance for task, model, occasion, verifier, language and interface is estimated.
Forms are linked with anchors and calibration data is sufficient.

evidence.detail: No universe is defined.
No G-study or hierarchical facet model exists.
No D-study design exists.
No anchors exist and form equivalence is not claimed.
No calibration sample exists in this repository.

rebuttals.detail: Six families, one form each.
Not estimable from one occasion and one model.
Declared as a facet with no observed levels.
Comparison across language and interface is withheld.
No calibration data.

inferences.claim: The result supports local self-diagnosis without unacceptable adverse consequences.
assumptions: No category, band, cut score, percentile or rank is emitted by anything this contract issues, at any stage. The legacy scorer's category is a separate surface and is disclosed in legacy_band_surface.
Forbidden uses are stated on the result itself.
Uncertainty and limitations travel with the number.

evidence.detail: category, cut_scores, percentile and rank are null in the construct map and null on every result this contract issues, and checkEcdContract fails the contract if any of them is set or if an ability category appears anywhere in the artifacts.

The product as a whole still emits an ability category: lib/scorer-v1.mjs assigns one and four modules render it. This evidence does not hold at the product level and is recorded as failing rather than scoped away, because the assumption above is only true of what this contract issues.
The forbidden use list is part of this artifact and travels with the result.
The registry categories are recorded here as statuses; none is a completed validation study.
No DIF or invariance evidence exists.
No consequence study has been run.

rebuttals.detail: Prohibited value sources are declared and no scoring rule may consume them, which closes the length, speed and turn-count routes and not the others.
The index is labelled descriptive and carries no category.
One language observed, no invariance evidence.
Stated as forbidden. A statement is not a control.
The checkpoint prompt is itself an intervention and may change what is being measured.
Raw evidence stays local and the public projection is a digest or safe summary.

A reader who sees the legacy scorer's category in the same CLI may take it for something this contract issued. Legacy results are rendered as historical and nothing here is derived from them, which is a presentation control and not a structural one.

validation_registry.detail: Six families were designed against the construct map; no content review by an independent panel has happened.
No think-aloud or process study exists.
No factor or dimensionality evidence exists. The construct map is a design, not a finding.
No external criterion has been collected.

release_note: Green CI is implementation evidence. It is not validity evidence, and no entry in the registry may be moved by a passing test run.
